page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block at the top: the main title lines in large capitals, then smaller lines of the author and academic details. Below them a woodcut vignette of an architectural arch with figures. Under the vignette the printer's imprint in small capitals, then a rule and the date. Faint mirrored show-through text lies across the title and the middle of the page; it is not printed text. No margins with text.
page.notes: The woodcut vignette (architectural arch with figures) is not transcribed. The faint mirrored lines between "DISPVTATIO." and the imprint are show-through from the reverse of the leaf and are omitted. Doubtful readings: "IOSVE" and "S. S." in the title block; the imprint name "Iacobum Lesnerium" is read from the small capitals and may be imperfect.
